description: Defines transformation functions and type mappings for tensor random number generation and distribution transformations in the ATen library, including utilities for uniform, normal, cauchy, exponential, geometric, log-normal, and Bernoulli distributions.

classes.name: DistAccumType
classes.description: Template struct for mapping types to accumulation types for distribution calculations.

methods.name: dist_acctype
methods.description: Type alias for the accumulation type corresponding to a given type T.

methods.name: uniform_int_from_to
methods.description: Transforms a value into a uniform integer within a specified range and base.

methods.name: uniform_int_full_range
methods.description: Transforms a value into a uniform integer over the full range of type T.

methods.name: uniform_int
methods.description: Transforms a value into a uniform integer of type T, with specializations for bool, int64_t, Half, BFloat16, and other integral types.

methods.name: uniform_real
methods.description: Transforms a value into a uniformly distributed real number between from and to.

methods.name: normal
methods.description: Transforms a standard normal distributed value to a normal distribution with specified mean and std.

methods.name: cauchy
methods.description: Transforms a uniform value into a Cauchy-distributed value with specified median and sigma.

methods.name: exponential
methods.description: Transforms a uniform value into an exponentially distributed value with specified lambda.

methods.name: geometric
methods.description: Transforms a uniform value into a geometrically distributed value with success probability p.

methods.name: log_normal
methods.description: Transforms a normal value into a log-normal distributed value.

methods.name: bernoulli
methods.description: Transforms a uniform value into a Bernoulli-distributed value with success probability p.
